product_vision: Build an iOS-first multi-list task app that lets longtime Google Tasks power users keep 30–40 lists, switch lists in one tap, archive and search history, and migrate with a guided import—so they are not stuck after Google’s list-menu regressions. North star: percentage of imported Google Tasks lists actively used weekly without users falling back to Google Tasks.

target_user_stories.persona: Longtime Google Tasks power user (30–40 lists)
target_user_stories.story: As a longtime Google Tasks power user with 30–40 lists, I want one-tap list switching and a visible list sidebar so that I can work across projects as fast as I did before the hamburger regression.
acceptance: Sidebar or dropdown shows all lists within 200ms of open
Switching lists preserves scroll position and incomplete tasks
User can pin up to 10 favorite lists for quick access

target_user_stories.story: As a multi-list iPad and iPhone user, I want archive with timestamps and full-text search so that I can recover old tasks without scrolling endless lists.
acceptance: Archive stores completed/archived tasks with timestamps
Full-text search returns results across lists in under 500ms for 10k tasks
User can restore an archived task to its original list

target_user_stories.persona: Google Tasks refugee ready to switch
target_user_stories.story: As a Google Tasks refugee forced to look for alternatives, I want a guided Google Tasks import and migration checklist so that I can move decades of lists without manual re-entry.
acceptance: OAuth or export-file import supports Google Tasks lists and tasks
Import progress shows lists completed and failures with retry
Migration checklist covers calendar sync, recurring tasks, and share links
Post-import summary email or in-app report lists counts migrated

target_user_stories.story: As a paying power user, I want reliable Google Calendar recurring sync and a clear Pro upgrade so that my daily ritual stays intact after leaving Google Tasks.
acceptance: Recurring tasks sync to Google Calendar when user connects account
Pro gate clearly lists multi-list sync, archive search, and import features
Billing uses App Store IAP with restore purchases
Sync failures surface actionable error messages

core_features.name: Multi-list sidebar switcher
core_features.description: Restore fast navigation across dozens of lists with a persistent sidebar/dropdown and pin favorites for power users.
acceptance_criteria: Supports at least 50 lists without UI lag on recent iPhones

core_features.name: Google Tasks import concierge
core_features.description: Guided import from Google Tasks (API and/or export) with progress, retries, and a migration checklist for calendar and recurring items.
acceptance_criteria: Imports lists and incomplete tasks with titles and notes
Retry failed lists without re-importing successes

core_features.name: Archive and full-text search
core_features.description: Archive completed work with timestamps and search across active and archived tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Archive action records timestamp and source list
Search covers title and notes fields
Restore from archive returns task to original list when possible

core_features.name: Google Calendar recurring sync
core_features.description: Optional Google Calendar connection for recurring tasks so daily rituals survive migration.
acceptance_criteria: User can connect Google Calendar with OAuth
Disconnect removes future sync without deleting local tasks

core_features.name: Pro subscription and IAP
core_features.description: Freemium core with Pro unlocking multi-device sync, archive search depth, and import concierge.
acceptance_criteria: StoreKit 2 purchase and restore works on iOS
Paywall copy matches App Store review themes
Free tier allows limited lists for trial

core_features.name: Migration waitlist landing
core_features.description: Lightweight web waitlist capturing App Store switch-intent reviewers before full App Store launch.
acceptance_criteria: Collects email and approximate list count
Confirms signup without spammy follow-up by default

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Power users can switch among 30+ lists efficiently
acceptance_criteria.definition_of_done: Median list-switch time under 300ms in Instruments on iPhone 13+ with 40 seeded lists

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Google Tasks import completes for typical power-user datasets
acceptance_criteria.definition_of_done: Import of 40 lists / 2000 tasks succeeds with less than 1% task loss on fixture dataset

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Archive and search recover historical tasks
acceptance_criteria.definition_of_done: QA script archives 100 tasks and finds each via search within 1s

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Switch-intent reviewers understand the value prop
acceptance_criteria.definition_of_done: At least 5 interview/waitlist users say import+list UX is reason to try
Paywall view, start trial, and purchase events fire to analytics

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No production cloud spend required for Stage 8 demo
acceptance_criteria.definition_of_done: Local/demo deploy artifacts document staging URLs on localhost only

success_metrics.north_star: Share of imported Google Tasks lists with at least one open action per week

technical_constraints: iOS-first MVP; Android deferred to post-validate
Must respect Google API quotas and App Store privacy rules
Local/demo Stage 8 only — no paid cloud production spend in this run
business_constraints: Recommendation remains validate; PRD enables learning not forced scale
Crowded task market; differentiate on Google Tasks migration UX
Budget for MVP kept under solo/small-team 6–8 week effort
assumptions: Enough App Store switch-intent users will try a paid import waitlist
Google will not fully restore the old list UX for all users soon
Users will grant calendar/tasks permissions when migration value is clear

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Google restores list UX and kills switch intent before launch
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Validate with interviews and waitlist first; keep MVP thin and import-led.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Todoist/Things already satisfy migrants after a painful switch
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Lead with one-click Google Tasks import and multi-list fidelity competitors undersell.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Google Tasks API limits block full import of large accounts
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Support export-file fallback and batch retries with clear progress UI.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: App Store rejection of subscription or Google data wording
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Use StoreKit 2, clear privacy nutrition labels, and avoid trademark misuse in title.

competitive_positioning.unique_value_prop: The Google Tasks refugee app: multi-list speed plus guided import/archive/search, not another generic Todoist clone.
why_us_over_competitors: Positioned explicitly for Google Tasks power users with 30–40 lists
Import concierge and migration checklist reduce decade-long switching cost
Archive+search restores workflows reviewers say Google removed
competitive_positioning.market_window: Window is the App Store regression echo; validate before Google fixes or competitors ship one-click import.

monetization_model.pricing_strategy: Free limited lists for trial; Pro at $4–8/mo or ~$40/yr unlocking unlimited lists, archive search depth, import concierge, and calendar sync via App Store IAP.
